Ariel — really appreciate the clear asks. I put together a concise "concierge commit pathways" overview to give procurement the tradeoffs at a glance. Snapshot below and I attached a one-page PDF + MOU draft for procurement to review. High-level: we provide three annual commit tiers (Starter, Growth, Enterprise) with a combination of per-token blended pricing, carryover allowances, and a capped burst pool. We can smooth billing monthly while keeping the annual commitment term for accounting.

Starter (SMB-friendly)
- Annual commit: 100M tokens
- Blended price: $14.50 / 1M tokens (approx)
- Discount vs pay-as-you-go: ~10%
- Carryover: up to 10% of unused tokens carried quarter-to-quarter
- Burst: 25% of monthly baseline available as pay-as-you-go at a +20% overage rate
- Ideal for pilots and small production launches

Growth (most customers move here)
- Annual commit: 500M tokens
- Blended price: $10.75 / 1M tokens (approx)
- Discount: ~28% vs pay-as-you-go
- Carryover: up to 20% of unused tokens carried month-to-month within the contract year
- Burst pool: 40% available with capped overage rate at blended +12%
- Includes token usage visibility & monthly review with Solutions Engineer

Enterprise (high-volume, SLA-backed)
- Annual commit: 1B+ tokens (custom tiers)
- Blended price: starting at $7.75 / 1M tokens (volume-backed)
- Discount: >40% at scale, step-down breakpoints available
- Carryover: flexible (negotiated), up to 25% with optional multi-year smoothing
- Burst pool: dedicated reserved capacity with guaranteed latency SLA; overages priced at negotiated blended tiers
- Includes Dedicated onboarding, audit logs, and an assigned CSM

Additional notes / unique features we can include:
- Concierge billing pathway: we can offer monthly invoicing with annual commitment lock, plus an interim crediting mechanism if you underutilize in Q1 (one-time true-up credit).
- First-year ramp credit: for new platform customers we can provide a phased credit (up to 15% applied across the first two quarters) to mitigate go‑live risk.
- DocuSign & procurement flow: attached MOU + editable pricing workbook.

I'll highlight areas we can flex: carryover cap, short-term credits, and burst pool sizing. If procurement wants smoothing and a 60-day opt-out in year one, we'll need leadership approval for the discount delta — I can surface that after you confirm the target band.

Attached: commit_summary_v1.pdf, mou_draft.docx, pricing_workbook.xlsx

Next step: would you like a redline-ready MOU or a single-page commercial term sheet for procurement?

Best,
